title: Chapter 560
text:
"Even the main cannon of the mothership couldn't kill him?"

Degulish's eyes widened in disbelief.

Ashes clenched his fists tightly, and his face turned green.

Terry's body trembled, and his face was filled with shock.

The battlefield was dead silent!

Han Xiao looked at the machinery fragments around him, and a pained expression flashed through his eyes. He was fine, but most of the machinery had been destroyed, and he had suffered a huge loss. He had 10,000,000 Enas in his account, and Godora still owed him 15,000,000 Enas. Money was not a problem, but the time he had lost was huge. After this battle, he would have to spend a long time in the machinery modification room to restore the current scale of the Mech Legion.

Han Technician counted the notifications on his interface. The power of the main cannon lasted for a few seconds, and it was split into multiple waves of damage. The first wave of damage was the highest, and the subsequent waves gradually decreased. The total damage was over 50,000, which was even higher than his maximum health. He had forcefully healed himself, and the various machinery and shields had reduced a portion of the damage.

After experiencing it personally, Han Xiaoxin had a rough idea. If he had not used the defensive measures earlier and used his body to take the main cannon head-on, he would have received over 80,000 damage, and his health regeneration would not have been able to keep up. He would have had to use Aurora's Character Summon Card again, and he only had three uses left. He still had one Void Travel.

I should be able to last a few more times. There's no need to escape immediately. I can still gamble on this mission. Why don't I …

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he casually waved his hand. The belly of the BlackLight Stealth opened, and dozens of compressed orbs shot out. He used his Mechanical Force to pull them onto his body, and he activated the backup Amphiptere mechanical suit. He had always had a habit of storing backup machinery, and there were a few other sets of equipment in the spaceship's warehouse.

The machinery and compressed orbs that he had originally brought with him were all destroyed, and even the Void Dragon mechanical suit was damaged. However, the bones of the Void Dragon race were tough enough, and the core materials were not completely destroyed. Furthermore, with his current position in Floating Dragon, it was easy for him to apply for the Void Dragon bones.

After putting on the mechanical suit, Han Xiao jumped out of the crater and flew into the air. Looking at the stunned Degulish, he displayed his thick skin and teased, "Hehe, I was lying.

"Hehe, I was just kidding. Actually, that was quite effective. Do you want to try it again? Maybe you can kill me. "

Degulish could hear the mocking tone in the voice, and his face turned purple from anger. He almost lost his composure as he roared into the communication device.

"Continue firing!"

If one shot was not enough, then two shots would be enough! He didn't believe it!

After saying that, Degulish leaped up like a cannonball, heading straight for Han Xiao. The mothership's main cannon needed to be recharged, and he wanted to entangle Han Xiao once more to prevent Black Star from escaping. Seeing that, Ashes and Terry could only put away their emotions and work together with Degulish, attacking from two other directions.

"Black Star, the mothership's main cannon has begun its second round of charging." Risda's voice rang out from within the mecha's helmet.

"Show me the time," Han Xiao said.

A countdown appeared on the top left corner of the tactical screen. The second main cannon would be fully charged and fired in forty seconds.

Han Xiao began to fight with the three of them once more. The Amphiptere's stats were far lower than the Void Dragon's, and it was turned into scrap metal in no time. However, he still had a few sets of compressed orbs from his backup mechanical suits, which he constantly changed and destroyed.

After fighting for a while, thirty seconds quickly passed, and the time for the second main cannon to fire was getting closer and closer.

Once again dragging Han Xiao to the ground, Degulish and the other two did the same as before, simultaneously opening up a distance to avoid the cannon fire.

However, this time, Han Xiao did not stay behind to defend himself. Instead, he turned and charged toward Terry, who was closest to him.

Han Xiao also knew the exact time to fire, and the enemy would not be suspicious because of this. After all, with the first example, they would only think that their dodging had alerted Black Star.

"He wants to drag Terry along to be attacked?"

Degulish instantly understood Han Xiao's intentions and was not surprised. With a cold snort, he said, "He won't be able to catch up to Terry."

The Calamity Grade Terry was even faster, and even with Han Xiao charging with all his might, the distance between them was constantly increasing. At this rate, he would definitely not be able to catch up.

Ashes suddenly froze and exclaimed, "No, stop the main cannon! Black Star has a flicker-like ability!"

During the battle, Han Xiao had only used [Void Travel] once, and that was to prevent Ashes from using his Esper ability. Ashes had almost been kicked in the crotch, and it had left a deep impression on him.

With his reminder, Degulish suddenly reacted. His expression changed as he hastily shouted into the communicator.

"Sh * t! Quickly cancel the lock! "

Right at this moment, Han Xiao used [Void Travel] and instantly appeared beside Terry, revealing an evil smile.

"Hehe, let's see who can tank better."

"No …"

Terry turned pale with fright and fear appeared in his eyes. He had a look of 'don't come here' on his face.

Boom!

The next moment, the second main cannon descended, and a second crater appeared on the ground.

Explosion, smoke, and shockwaves. Just like the previous cannon, the people within the protective shield once again experienced the feeling of an earthquake.

Only when the smoke dissipated did they realize that the cannon had missed, hitting tens of kilometers away and not hitting Han Xiao's position.

At the critical moment, Dark-star's temporary commander hurriedly moved the cannon away.

Terry's mouth was wide open as he looked at the crater in the distance. He was so frightened that he broke out in cold sweat, and he hurriedly escaped from Han Xiao's side, running more than a thousand meters away.

Having escaped death, Terry still had some lingering fear in his heart as he panted heavily.

"Tsk, consider yourself lucky."

Han Xiao stood where he was and curled his lips, feeling that it was a pity.

If Dark-star had not reacted in time, the enemy would have reaped what they had sown. Killing one of their high-level combatants in one shot, he would have gotten back some interest and at least left one enemy behind.

However, not hitting was also effective … Han Xiao shook his head and turned to look at Degulish. He shrugged and pretended to feel pity.

"What are you going to say next? Are you going to fire or not?"

"You!"

Degulish gritted his teeth and almost crushed his communicator. However, he did not dare to use his main cannon on Han Xiao, for fear of harming the innocent.

Black Star had withstood the first shot, and the second shot had almost killed Terry. The results of these two shots showed that the main cannon was completely useless against Black Star and could even injure themselves!

The three of them were unable to kill Black Star, and the strongest main cannon of the mothership was also unable to do anything to him. The three of them had realized that even though Black Star could not beat them, the rhythm of the battle had fallen into his hands! Before this, they had never thought that a fellow who had not even reached the Calamity Grade would be able to cause so much trouble!

He could not be beaten up, and he could not be killed. Then, should they bring Black Star onto the ship?

Degulish immediately rejected this idea. What a joke! How would he dare to bring this fellow onto the spaceship?

Right at this moment, the temporary commander urgently reported the new situation.

"A strong spatial fluctuation has been detected nearby. Godora's fleet has broken through the spatial disturbance and is currently providing support through the hyperdrive base station. Enemies are continuously appearing, and there is not much time left. We have to quickly retreat."

Han Xiao also received Nagojin's message at the same time and heaved a sigh of relief. Godora's reinforcements had finally arrived. Although they would be late, they would definitely arrive.

Degulish's expression was extremely ugly. He had no other choice but to accept the result of the mission failure. The three of them had been delayed by Han Xiao for too long and had not been able to cause any more damage to Blue Star.

Dark-star's fleet began to retreat, and Degulish and the other two escaped from the battle and boarded the assault spaceship.

Right at this moment, the three of them suddenly heard Han Xiao's soft laughter.

"Come and play when you're free."

Han Xiao smiled and waved his hand, adding in his heart, If you guys still have the chance.

"Just you wait. I hope you can still laugh in the future!"

Degulish's expression was gloomy as he turned around and entered the spaceship.

Ashes looked deeply at Han Xiao. Next time, I'll definitely find a way to kill you.

Dark-star's assault spaceships that had attacked Blue Star all took off, and the mothership outside the atmosphere began to leave.

As the reinforcements from Godora's fleet were too large, almost all the other calamity planets' fleet had arrived. Dark-star did not wish to engage in a firefight and hurriedly retreated.

Looking at Dark-star's fleet disappearing into the horizon, Han Xiao retracted his gaze and looked at the devastated Sanctuary. He kept the smile on his face and sighed with a heavy expression.

This time, they had suffered heavy losses.

The base was fine, but most of the Sanctuaries outside had been destroyed and turned into ruins. The number of casualties had not been calculated, but it was definitely not small. Including the Six Nations, a conservative estimate put the number of casualties at over ten million.

After surviving the Mutation Disaster with much difficulty, the survivors had encountered a sudden disaster, and their civilization had suffered a heavy blow.

The only good news was that the Blue Star Civilization had not been completely destroyed.

"Bennett, calculate the losses and treat the injured."

With a sigh, Han Xiao used his communicator to issue an order before lying down with his face facing the sky.

The moment the pressure disappeared, the tiredness that he had forced himself to endure exploded, engulfing his entire body like a tsunami. He did not even want to move a single finger.

This battle had exhausted him to death.

Thankfully, while the losses were heavy, the outcome was not irreversible. Everything had finally come to an end.

Nagojin landed at the side and looked at Han Xiao with a complicated expression. The shock in his heart was like a tsunami.

Dark-star had attacked the defenseless Blue Star, mobilizing three Calamity Grade Supers, but to no avail. Even the main cannon had not been able to kill Black Star. In other words, it was equivalent to Black Star holding back three Calamity Grade Supers and preventing them from destroying the planet. In the end, Dark-star was forced to retreat.

Nagakin could almost imagine how big of an uproar this news would cause in the Shattered Star Ring in the following days!
